proof_body:
by
  intro a b c ha
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, q, h, hp, hq⟩
    have h0 := h 0
    have h1 := h 1
    have h2 := h (-1)
    have hb : b = -a * (p + q) := by linear_combination (1 / 2) * h1 - (1 / 2) * h2
    have hc : c = a * p * q := by linear_combination h0
    have e1 : -b / a = p + q := by
      rw [div_eq_iff ha, hb]
      ring
    have e2 : c / a = p * q := by
      rw [div_eq_iff ha, hc]
      ring
    rw [e1, e2]
    refine ⟨?_, by linarith, mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg hp hq⟩
    have e : b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c = (a * (p - q)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hb, hc]
      ring
    rw [e]
    exact sq_nonneg _
  · rintro ⟨hD, h1, h2⟩
    obtain ⟨v, t, ht, hb, hc, hv⟩ : ∃ v t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ b = -2 * a * v ∧ c = a * (v ^ 2 - t ^ 2) ∧ v = -b / (2 * a) := by
      have hs2 := Real.sq_sqrt hD
      refine ⟨-b / (2 * a), |Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c) / (2 * a)|, abs_nonneg _, by field_simp, ?_, rfl⟩
      rw [sq_abs, div_pow, div_pow, hs2]
      field_simp
      ring
    clear hv hD
    have e1 : -b / a = 2 * v := by
      rw [div_eq_iff ha, hb]
      ring
    have e2 : c / a = (v - t) * (v + t) := by
      rw [div_eq_iff ha, hc]
      ring
    rw [e1] at h1
    rw [e2] at h2
    rcases pos_and_pos_or_neg_and_neg_of_mul_pos h2 with ⟨h3, h4⟩ | ⟨h3, h4⟩
    · exfalso
      linarith
    · exact ⟨v - t, v + t, fun x => by rw [hb, hc]; ring, h3, h4⟩
